cards.ex: The scientist's controversial theory is sure to spark debate among experts.
cards.exUz: Olimning bahsli nazariyasi, albatta, mutaxassislar o'rtasida bahs uyg'otadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir mavzu bo'yicha qizg'in muhokamani boshlash, munozaraga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: New drugs undergo rigorous testing before they can be sold to the public.
cards.exUz: Yangi dorilar xalqqa sotilishidan oldin qattiq sinovdan o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy va batafsil tekshiruv, qat'iy sinovdan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: Independent studies are needed to validate the findings of this research.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tadqiqot natijalarini tasdiqlash uchun mustaqil tadqiqotlar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Olingan natijalarni ishonchli ekanligini isbotlash, haqiqiyligini tasdiqlash.

cards.ex: The study is based on a solid theoretical framework.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tadqiqot mustahkam nazariy asosga ega.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot uchun asos bo'ladigan nazariy tushunchalar va tamoyillar to'plami.

cards.ex: Good research always questions assumptions and seeks alternative explanations.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi tadqiqot har doim farazlarni so'roq ostiga oladi va muqobil izohlarni qidiradi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda qabul qilinadigan narsalarga shubha bilan qarash, tekshirish.

cards.ex: This research sheds light on the causes of the disease.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tadqiqot kasallik sabablariga yorug'lik soladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida yangi ma'lumot berish, tushuntirishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: The experiment didn't yield the results we were hoping for.
cards.exUz: Tajriba biz umid qilgan natijalarni bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot yoki urinishdan ma'lum bir natijaga erishish.

cards.ex: Many scientific advancements stem from curiosity and a desire to understand the world.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina ilmiy yutuqlar qiziquvchanlik va dunyoni tushunish istagidan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning manbai bo'lmoq, sababi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Data mining is used to identify trends in consumer behavior.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot qazish iste'molchilar xatti-harakatidagi tendentsiyalarni aniqlash uchun ishlatiladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi ma'lumotlardan foydali axborotlarni qidirish va aniqlash jarayoni.

cards.ex: The theory is supported by robust evidence from multiple studies.
cards.exUz: Nazariya ko'plab tadqiqotlardan olingan mustahkam dalillar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli, ishonchli va yetarli darajada dalillar majmuasi.

cards.ex: The field of medicine has a vast body of knowledge accumulated over centuries.
cards.exUz: Tibbiyot sohasi asrlar davomida to'plangan katta bilimlar to'plamiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir sohada to'plangan va tashkil etilgan bilimlar majmuasi.

cards.ex: The project requires a cross-disciplinary approach, involving experts from different fields.
cards.exUz: Loyiha turli sohalardagi mutaxassislarni jalb qilgan fanlararo yondashuvni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Turli sohalar yoki fanlar o'rtasidagi aloqani o'rganuvchi.

cards.ex: Let's drill down into the specific data points to understand the anomaly.
cards.exUz: Anomaliyani tushunish uchun aniq ma'lumotlarga chuqurroq kirib boraylik.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni chuqurroq o'rganish, batafsilroq tahlil qilish.

cards.ex: The initial results fell short of our expectations, so we had to adjust the experiment.
cards.exUz: Dastlabki natijalar bizning umidlarimizga yetmadi, shuning uchun tajribani sozlashimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijalarga erisha olmaslik, kerakli darajaga yetmaslik.

cards.ex: With this new evidence, the theory is now on firm footing.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi dalil bilan nazariya endi mustahkam asosga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchli va barqaror asosga ega bo'lish, mustahkam poydevorda turish.

cards.ex: Government funding can spur innovation in renewable energy technologies.
cards.exUz: Hukumat tomonidan moliyalashtirish qayta tiklanadigan energiya texnologiyalarida innovatsiyalarni rag'batlantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalar va texnologiyalarning paydo bo'lishini tezlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The evidence points to a connection between diet and cancer risk.
cards.exUz: Dalillar ovqatlanish va saraton xavfi o'rtasida bog'liqlik borligini ko'rsatadi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar biror narsani tasdiqlaydi yoki ehtimolini oshiradi.

cards.ex: Whether or not life exists on other planets remains a matter of conjecture.
cards.exUz: Boshqa sayyoralarda hayot bormi yoki yo'qmi, bu hali ham taxminiy masala.
cards.uzDef: Hali aniq isbotlanmagan, faqat taxminlarga asoslangan masala.

cards.ex: The effectiveness of the drug was tested using a double-blind study.
cards.exUz: Preparatning samaradorligi ikki tomonlama yashirin tadqiqot yordamida sinovdan o'tkazildi.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqotda na tadqiqotchilar, na ishtirokchilar kim nima olayotganini bilmaydi.

cards.ex: Scientists are constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
cards.exUz: Olimlar doimiy ravishda mumkin bo'lgan narsalar chegaralarini kengaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bilimlarning yoki imkoniyatlarning chegaralarini kengaytirish.

cards.ex: Understanding the underpinning principles of physics is crucial for engineers.
cards.exUz: Fizikaning asosiy tamoyillarini tushunish muhandislar uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Nazariya, tizim yoki harakatning asosida yotuvchi asosiy g'oyalar.

cards.ex: Once we gathered all the data, the pieces of the puzzle started to fall into place.
cards.exUz: Barcha ma'lumotlarni to'plaganimizdan so'ng, jumboqning bo'laklari joy-joyiga tusha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta narsalar birgalikda aniq va tushunarli bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: We need to explore all avenues to find a solution to this problem.
cards.exUz: Ushbu muammoni hal qilish uchun barcha yo'llarni o'rganishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki biror maqsadga erishish uchun turli xil imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: In light of the new evidence, we need to reconsider our approach.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, yondashuvimizni qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani hisobga olgan holda, shunga ko'ra.

cards.ex: The results showed a high level of statistical significance.
cards.exUz: Natijalar yuqori darajadagi statistik ahamiyatni ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Natija tasodifiy emasligini ko'rsatuvchi statistik o'lchov.

cards.ex: I'm at a loss to explain these unexpected results.
cards.exUz: Ushbu kutilmagan natijalarni qanday tushuntirishni bilmay bosh qotirmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Qanday qilishni yoki nima deyishni bilmaslik, hayron bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's important to identify the underlying cause of the problem, not just treat the symptoms.
cards.exUz: Faqat alomatlarni davolash emas, balki muammoning asosiy sababini aniqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning yoki hodisaning yuzaga kelishiga sabab bo'lgan asosiy omil.

cards.ex: Researchers have drawn parallels between the two studies, despite their different methodologies.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotchilar turli xil uslublarga qaramay, ikkala tadqiqot o'rtasida o'xshashliklar topdilar.
cards.uzDef: Ikkita narsa o'rtasida o'xshashliklarni yoki bog'liqliklarni aniqlash.

cards.ex: Before starting the experiment, we need to formulate a clear hypothesis.
cards.exUz: Tajribani boshlashdan oldin biz aniq farazni shakllantirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot uchun sinovdan o'tkaziladigan bir taxminiy g'oyani tuzish.

cards.ex: The new study is likely to spur debate among scientists.
cards.exUz: Yangi tadqiqot olimlar o'rtasida munozaraga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qizg'in muhokamaga turtki bo'lish, bahs-munozaralarga olib kelish.
